### Summary

<!-- What does this change and why. Link issues with "Fixes #NN". -->

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (API surface, default behavior, or wire format)
- [ ] Documentation / build / CI only

### Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated and `dotnet test -c Release` passes locally.
- [ ] `PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt` updated for any public API change.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased".
- [ ] `KNOWN-GAPS.md` updated if scope or caveats changed.
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies, or motivation explained.
- [ ] If touching a cryptographic primitive: KATs added from an authoritative source.
